summary:
I was so pleased to get the letter from you. By now I guess you’ve taken your flight test. Did you pass? As to my phone number, it’s 714-524-7306. Call me after six pm collect any day, okay? It’s much better talking on the phone, right? 

For the last five weeks I’ve really been down—with the flu and with financial worries. Anyhow now I’m over the flu and we got in some money. We couldn’t even pay our rent or the doctor. That’s the life of a freelance writer, and I know it, but when you have a three month old baby it gets really scary. You wonder what would happen if the baby got very sick ... there isn’t the health plan here that you have in Canada. 

I forget what news I told you. About the French TV interview with me at Disney­ land, I guess, and my sale to the movies. It was the exhaustion of filming that brought on the flu. In about two weeks I’ll have copies of the slick magazine Vertex with their interview with me ... they sent me some of the pictures they’re using and they are super all right Soon as I have a copy I’ll send it to you. 

Also I’ve been going to the mental health place, except when I’ve been too depressed to go, which is sort of a paradox—being too fucked up to go in for therapy. I guess you could say I had a true nervous breakdown after the baby came, from worry, although I’m not sure why. On the other hand, he’s a neat baby; he looks like an elf. That’s about all that kept me going, was the baby. And Tessa took good care of me. For three weeks I could...
